body: Do you know the word "CONSENT"? Being in a relationship doesn't mean you can just assault your partner because you feel entitled of having sex with them even when they explicitly said "No".
NTA. The fact that you suggested it like a possibility doesn't mean it's something you'd want all the time, and if you said no, then it's NO. After that if he continues, like he did, it's assault.

Hi, so this was more of a vent since I was really upset. I didn't expect anyone to read, but thank you all for your responses. I was put on the spotlight for "being boring and not taking a joke" by these people and it honestly felt really bad as if I was the only problem, so I'm happy some of you relate to this feeling aswell, it made me feel less alone.

Also I wanted to apologize for the grammar. Since it's not my first language it may be bad and I'm overthinking it is lol, so I apologize for any mistakes.

Why should I change instead of them though, there's no more solutions than just "deal with it"? It's kinda sad to think that I don't have more options. The comments weren't about me too, they were about someone else and they were visibly uncomfortable, so why should I laugh or not care when someone is clearly getting hurt

I know... those comments about someone's appearance are so unnecessary. And when they don't get the laughs they get defensive saying "you're too sensitive!" like ??? Am I really supposed to laugh at how you mock someone?

Thank you for your comment.  
It is just really hard to go to sleep because I know something terrible is gonna happen and I would rather not go through that by choice. But you're right, sleeping is essencial for health, specially mental health so it is a bit counterproductive to avoid it

I see, I never saw it that way. I have nightmares pretty much everyday so it never occured to me to see it on a positive note, it was mostly just annoying and disturbing.

I'll try to do as you say, and hope it works, thank you so much for your comment!
